content: I don't think this is current. Mine didn't ever ask me to put it in the grove in the bin. I did it twice. It seemed like it just probed the bin with the nozzle tip.

As jetuser said, this needs better images both in the printer firmware and here as well.

This will affect your every print (and nozzle changes) as the print won't start if the nozzle has even - and I'm not joking - a tiny drop of filament in tip of it (the tool offset will fail during print startup).
I think the picture for the Z-Alignment could use improvement, to better illustrate expected nozzle pressure/placement in the v groove wiper
